pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K tonight (Item 3.02 conversion issuance, a new financing, or an Item 1.01 with Avondale) would make the negative larger. A Form 4 buy or a confirmed contract would flip it.

positioning_check: FINRA settlement 2026-09-15: 242,776 shares short, 1.55 days to cover, -1.2% vs 08/31 (Nasdaq API, https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/CXAI/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). These figures are post-split and lag about 8 business days, so the position carried into this fall is not observable. With roughly 2.34M shares outstanding post-split (116.9M on 2026-08-12 / 50, per the 10-Q cover), short interest is about 10% of shares. That is not crowded on days to cover. No usable options chain, so there is no skew (put/call OI 0.13 on 876 contracts). No insider trades in 12 months (Nasdaq insider API).

findings.finding: A standing dilution supply could sell into any bounce on 2026-10-07. The 10-Q filed 2026-08-14 discloses Avondale pre-paid convertible purchases (~$33.7M of a $40M SPA undrawn; outstanding tranches convertible at the lower of a fixed price or 91% of the lowest daily VWAP over the prior 10 trading days, above per-tranche floors), $10.1M fair value of convertibles, an ATM program of $7.96M ($2.5M sold in H1), and $3.5M left on a Streeterville SPA. Two falling sessions in a row have reset the 10-day lowest VWAP lower, which makes conversion more attractive.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Conversions and ATM sales can execute on any session without prior notice, including 2026-10-07. No specific draw is dated. This is inference from disclosed terms, sized small for that reason. A caveat cuts against it: post-split, the stock may be near or below some tranches' floor prices, which could stall conversions. Whether the floors are split-adjusted is not confirmed from the document read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the reverse split (2026-08-18) the stock is down 73% over 60 sessions. Of its own last 12 comparable falls, 8 had a negative next close, including 08-14 → -19.8%, 08-17 → -4.3% and 10-05 → -9.6% (today). Baseline history.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is known, but the price only reflects supply that has already sold. If tomorrow's conversion or ATM flow were in the close, the stock would be holding a level rather than making a new 52-week low (pos_52w 0.001) on its second -10% day with no news.
findings.independence: Repeated Item 3.02 8-Ks (2025-12-12, 2026-01-30, 2026-03-26, 2026-04-10, 2026-04-17, 2026-05-28, 2026-06-03) show the issuance cadence before the split. https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001820875.json
